title: MV [SOLVED] Can I see MapID after changing the name of the map?

posts.author: damieneon
posts.body:
Hey everyone! I'm very new to RPG Maker MV. When I started my game i changed the names of the map IDs for my own convenience, and now when I want to use the ID in events and add layers I have issues knowing which map has which ID so it shows correctly. Is there a way to reset a map ID to its original state or something like that so that I can see it?
Thank you, I am suffering.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
You're not changing Map IDs at all, it's literally just the name. You can however see the ID of the selected map at the bottom of the editor:
as well as the current zoom level and the coordinates of the currently selected tile (hovered when in layer mode, selected when in event mode) and the map name as well as the size.
In terms of "showing correctly" I wouldn't worry about it. The ID has no impact on anything other than the engine knowing which map is what internally. It makes no difference if you start the map tree on map 504033 or 1, so I'd recommend keeping your current order, or ordering them in the order the player can/will access them, depending on what kinda game you're making. (And in terms of using the map ID in events... Like in the transfer event command, wouldn't it be easier to have names displayed rather than just IDs anyway?)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Small addition for completion's sake. You can also see the ID when opening the map properties (Edit)

posts.author: Rethy
posts.body:
Another bit for completion sake, you can find event IDs very similarly.
Selecting an event will show its ID and name just to the right of the coordinates.
Also similar to maps, it shows up in the top left of the event editor.
